source: Actual authored camps and World from the zone waypoint; actual standard build at the declared stage-clear clock.

rules.name: 剑气
rules.description: 每第 3 次命中敌人的技能释放，在目标处爆发剑气（35% 伤害，半径 2.2）

combos.name: 剑气
combos.description: 每第 3 次命中敌人的技能释放，在目标处爆发剑气（35% 伤害，半径 2.2）

limits: Actual authored geometry, camp templates/levels/budgets, streamed chunks and World movement/combat. The player receives no extra HP, mana, healing or damage multipliers.
The route visits each target-zone camp once, starting at the declared landing or explicit controlled start. All nearby camps, including other zones, remain present and can engage.
This measures initial-cycle route efficiency. No respawn, rewards, server settlement or natural sustainable drop-frequency claim is made; those require persistent camp/source probes.
Mean TTK is conditional on kills. Unfinished camps, deaths, failed casts and zero-kill runs remain visible in the sample and aggregate rate.
